posts.title: Music and "The Benedict Option"
posts.description: Reading Rod Dreher's book, "The Benedict Option", has sent my thinking careening back onto the subject of music in worship. More than that, it made me realize how important the subject is. Having felt like I would not succeed in my goal of playing a role in making the church's music more meaningful, I set the subject aside for seven years thinking I was finished with the topic.
